title: Lifted Payments Payment Statement Audit Model
subtitle: A processor-neutral schema and synthetic merchant statement audit example
description: Package 1.1.2 of the Lifted Payments processor-neutral model for normalizing monthly merchant payment-processing statement totals, preserving the schema 1.1.0 record contract. The package contains a CSV template, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contract, Decimal-safe companion validator, methodology, synthetic adversarial vectors, reproducible validation report, citation metadata, and SHA-256 checksums. Canonical methodology: https://liftedpayments.com/payment-processing-statement-audit/ . Version DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21763617 . No real merchant or cardholder data is included.

resources.description: Spreadsheet-ready header for one monthly payment statement audit record.
JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation contract for audit records.
Complete synthetic example with no real merchant or cardholder data.
SHA-256 integrity values for the portable source files.
